diff --git a/notes.py b/notes.py
index cba2c85..f1484fa 100644
--- a/notes.py
+++ b/notes.py
@@ -24,5 +24,14 @@ def all_tags(notes):
 
 
 def tag_counts(notes):
-    """How many notes carry each tag."""
-    raise NotImplementedError
+    """How many notes carry each tag.
+
+    Tags are normalized with norm_tag(), and each note counts at most once
+    per tag, even if it carries several spellings of it. Returned as a dict
+    ordered by count (descending), then tag name.
+    """
+    counts = {}
+    for n in notes:
+        for t in {norm_tag(t) for t in n["tags"]}:
+            counts[t] = counts.get(t, 0) + 1
+    return dict(sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0])))
diff --git a/tests/test_notes.py b/tests/test_notes.py
index 5530666..e008be9 100644
--- a/tests/test_notes.py
+++ b/tests/test_notes.py
@@ -17,3 +17,12 @@ def test_with_tag_ignores_case_and_spaces():
 
 def test_all_tags():
     assert notes.all_tags(NOTES) == ["history", "poetry"]
+
+
+def test_tag_counts_merges_spellings():
+    assert notes.tag_counts(NOTES) == {"poetry": 2, "history": 1}
+
+
+def test_tag_counts_counts_note_once_per_tag():
+    dup = [{"title": "d", "tags": ["Poetry", " poetry", "POETRY"]}]
+    assert notes.tag_counts(dup) == {"poetry": 1}
